review.notes:
Earlier transitions are cosmetic and precede the baseline's recorded version: v0 (EEN-EN011, 2005-11-16) -> v1 (DP2-EN008, 2006-02-08) -> v2 (DR04-EN071, 2007-11-14) shed "during your Main Phase, if you control this card on the field", "as an Equip Card" and "increase the ATK and DEF ... by 400 points", but every one of them keeps the 1-Union-per-monster Condition, the battle-only destruction replacement and the face-up Attack Position clause. v2 is the text in force at the Edison snapshot (2010-04-24) and is what upstream modelled the baseline cdb text on (packet ratio 0.864; upstream wrote v3's PSCT targeting phrasing while retaining the era clauses, so the cdb text is a hybrid matching no printed version - the behavioural anchor is v2). The card postdates the GOAT snapshot (first TCG printing 2005-11-16). v3 also changes the card-type line from [Machine/Union] to [Machine/Union/Effect]. Trailing v3 -> v4 (SGX1-ENC09, 2022-03-17) only moves the ATK/DEF sentence to the end: cosmetic, not recorded. Dating note: EdisonFormat corroborates the era Condition and attributes its removal to the 2016 Structure Deck: Seto Kaiba / 2017 Duelist Saga wave - the site's own claim, which would put the erratum earlier than this card's first reprint carrying the new text (LCKC-EN083, 2018-03-08, the anchor recorded here per the set-release rule). Both candidate datings are years after the GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) snapshots, so the ambiguity cannot change format applicability.

Round 037 (2026-09-29). Checked against period rulings: the differences the functional transition claims were searched for in the Konami-hosted UDE card FAQ (2008-12), the 2005 UDE card rulings page, Konami's errata lists, rulebooks and per-set ruling documents, and the archived UDE judge-list threads Yugipedia points to (the transition's rulings_check; docs/research/text-only-errata-audit.md, W-Wing Catapult). The rulings read support d1, d2, d3 at both snapshots (the passages are in the check); nothing contradicts a claimed difference, so kind, summary and coverage are unchanged. Verdicts: [event] d1 supported at Edison, supported at Tengu; d2 supported at Edison, supported at Tengu; d3 supported at Edison, supported at Tengu; d4 unresolved at Edison, unresolved at Tengu.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the errata'd text (LCKC-EN083, Legendary Collection Kaiba Mega Pack)

event.historical_text: Once per turn, you can equip this card to a "V-Tiger Jet" you control, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. When equipped to a monster by this card's effect, the equipped monster gains 400 ATK and DEF. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)
event.modern_text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "V-Tiger Jet" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 400 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.
event.summary: Functional erratum with three concrete effects, encoded upstream by calling aux.AddUnionProcedure(c,s.filter,true) (old union rules) instead of the modern aux.AddUnionProcedure(c,aux.FilterBoolFunction(Card.IsCode,51638941)). (1) The era Condition "(A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time)": the pre-errata equip target must have GetUnionCount()==0, so a "V-Tiger Jet" already carrying a Union monster cannot be equipped, while the modern card has no such limit. (2) The destruction replacement is battle-only - Auxiliary.UnionReplace(true) returns true only for REASON_BATTLE - whereas the modern text and script also substitute for destruction by card effect. (3) Unequipping Special Summons the card specifically in face-up Attack Position (POS_FACEUP_ATTACK) rather than a position of the player's choice, and both the unequip option and the 400 ATK/DEF gain are conditioned on aux.IsUnionState (proper union status) instead of merely being equipped.

rulings_check.difference: Era text carries the Union condition '(A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time)': a V-Tiger Jet already carrying a Union monster cannot be equipped with this card. The modern card has no such limit. Era destruction replacement is battle-only ('If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead'); the modern text also replaces destruction by card effect. Era: 'When equipped to a monster by this card's effect, the equipped monster gains 400 ATK and DEF', and the unequip option only works in proper Union state; modern: a monster equipped with this card gains 400 ATK/DEF however it was equipped. Era unequip Special Summons the card in face-up Attack Position; the modern text just says 'Special Summon it' (a position of the player's choice).
